IONYX PTY LTD is a technology and systems provider focused on improving how organisations operate through practical, well-designed solutions. We work closely with organisations to understand their environment, challenges, and priorities. As a Developer Programmer at IONYX, you will play a crucial role in crafting innovative solutions that drive our clients' success. - Develop and maintain high-quality software solutions to meet business needs.

- Participate in code reviews to ensure accuracy and functionality.

- Address bugs and improve application performance.

- Assist in the development and implementation of software updates and upgrades.

- Engage with stakeholders to understand their requirements and translate them into technical specifications.

- Provide technical support and training to other team members.

- Ensure the alignment of technical solutions with business goals.

- Continuously explore new technologies to maximise development efficiency.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

- Proficiency in one or more coding languages such as Python, Java, or C#.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a team environment.

- Adaptability to new situations and technologies.

- 1 year of experience in a similar role is required.

Sonar develops and implements software products that automate operational workflows across transport and logistics, mobile workforce management, warehousing, field services, retail and healthcare. Its solutions provide capabilities such as job scheduling, dispatch management, route optimisation, real-time tracking, inventory management, reporting and integration with existing ERP and CRM platforms.   About the Role   The role will primarily involve C# and .NET application development, API integration, database-driven software solutions and the deployment of applications through modern cloud and container environments.   Key Responsibilities    Analyse business requirements, functional specifications and existing application workflows.  Develop, maintain and enhance software applications using C#, .NET and related technologies. Develop and maintain database-driven functionality using SQL and relational database technologies.  Develop and maintain automated build, testing and deployment processes through CI/CD pipelines.  Assist with the deployment and operation of applications in cloud environments such as Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure or AWS.  Monitor application performance, investigate runtime issues and implement software-level fixes.  Develop internal utilities and automation tools using technologies such as Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash.  Prepare and maintain technical documentation, deployment instructions and operational procedures.  Work with software architects, developers, project teams and support personnel throughout the software development lifecycle.    Qualifications and Experience    Bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a closely related discipline.  At least one year of relevant software development or closely related commercial experience.  Practical experience developing applications or APIs using C# and .NET.  Experience with REST APIs and system integration.  Familiarity with cloud platforms such as GCP, Azure or AWS.  Familiarity with CI/CD tools and source-control platforms such as Bitbucket or Git.    Desirable Skills    Experience modernising legacy .NET applications.  Experience developing software for logistics, workforce management, warehousing, healthcare or other operational environments.  Knowledge of real-time data processing, GPS, mobile applications, reporting systems or ERP/CRM integration.  Experience with Python, Go, PowerShell or Bash scripting.  Understanding of application monitoring tools and cloud-based observability  Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.         About Company    Mansys is an Australian recruitment service focused on tradespeople and other in-demand workers.
